situation: A company must choose between a broad product launch and a focused launch while demand and supplier capacity remain uncertain.
question: Which launch scope should the company commit to?

options.label: Broad launch
options.description: Launch the full range across all channels.

options.label: Focused launch
options.description: Launch the highest-confidence products in selected channels.

jointEffects.label: Demand overwhelms constrained supply
jointEffects.assumption: High demand creates value for the broad launch only when supplier capacity can fulfil the wider range; otherwise shortages and recovery costs create an additional loss.

assumptions: The joint loss is a stress-test assumption and must be replaced with operational evidence before a real commitment.
